summary: MATERIAL CHANGE: Juwan Johnson receiving yards moves from WATCH at the 38.5 consensus area to BET_NOW because a current-access bet365 price outlier is O34.5 -115. Covers timestamped the multi-book board Sat Sep 19 at 00:05 ET and shows bet365 O34.5 -115 versus DraftKings O37.5 -110 and most regulated books at O38.5. VegasInsider, crawled on Sep 19, independently displays the same 34.5 -115 outlier among a 37.5-38.5 cluster. Johnson is off the final Saints injury report after DNP-LP-FP, while Chris Olave is questionable with a hamstring injury. Week 1 role was 77.8% route share, 10.7% target share, 14.6% first-read share, seven targets and three red-zone targets; he produced 54 yards. Independent projections remain dispersed but mostly above 34.5: numberFire 53.36, prior FIC 49.5, prior DynastySpec 46.0, and prior MatchWiz 37.3. Baltimore is a tougher TE matchup, and rain chances increase during the game, so the recommendation is price-specific rather than a blanket Over. PRIME assigns a conservative 60% fair Over probability at 34.5 (fair odds about -150) versus 53.49% raw break-even at -115, a +6.51 percentage-point edge. Formal play is 0.5u at bet365 O34.5 -115, maximum -120; verify the live app immediately before placement. Do not transfer this approval to 38.5. Jonathan Taylor O15.5 -120 BetMGM and Dalton Schultz O41.5 -114 FanDuel remain unchanged prior BET theses; Rico Dowdle attempts remains PASS_AFTER_MOVE. No confirmed Week 2 straight ticket exists in bet_history and no new Grok pass exists.

decisions.rationale: The bet is created by the threshold/price dislocation, not by a projection alone. A timestamped multi-book board shows bet365 O34.5 -115 while most books are 38.5 and DraftKings is 37.5 -110. Johnson's Week 1 route/target/first-read/red-zone involvement was stable enough to support a receiving-yard floor, and his illness is cleared from the final report. Independent projections are dispersed, so PRIME discounts the bullish models and uses a conservative 60% fair probability rather than mechanically treating the projection gap as edge.
